name: mcp-export
description: Exposes brAIn nodes as an external MCP server. The mirror of mcp-server: instead of consuming an external MCP, it spins up an HTTP MCP endpoint where each declared tool maps to a bus topic. When a remote MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor, …) calls a tool, the node publishes on the topic, awaits the reply, and returns it. One mcp-export instance = one HTTP endpoint; spawn multiple if you want different curated tool sets.
